newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF denies Trust Fund Bureau to cut JGB buying.
newsitem.headline: MOF denies Trust Fund Bureau to cut JGB buying.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) denied market talk on Wednesday that its Trust Fund Bureau was planning to reduce or even halt outright purchases of Japanese government bonds (JGBs).
"It is not true that we have decided something new," said a MOF official.
The bureau has been buying 100 billion yen worth of long-term JGBs from the secondary market twice a month since June 1996.
Similar market talk spread among bond traders in the second week of April when the market expected the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to buy bonds outright.
The BOJ delayed in buying JGBs outright, leading some to believe that MOF's Trust Fund Bureau might follow suit and possibly reduce the amount of its JGB buying.
But the BOJ bought 100 billion yen worth of JGBs outright on April 11. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
